prewrittenFacts.statement: The year is uncertain between 1986 and 1987; neither is confirmed.
The brass lantern was placed on the kitchen floor away from curtains.
Nobody was injured and there was no house fire.
A neighbour bringing matches is an uncertain recollection.
The narrator left the album date unknown rather than choosing a year.

result.original: My aunt Rukhsana remembers a power cut during an Eid dinner, but she cannot decide whether it happened in 1986 or 1987. There is no date on the photograph. My grandfather lit a small brass lantern and put it on the kitchen floor, away from the curtains. Nobody was injured, and the house did not catch fire. Rukhsana remembers her sister carrying rice from the kitchen while the rest of the family waited in the courtyard. She thinks a neighbour brought matches, although she is less sure about that detail than the lantern itself. I wrote down both possible years. When my cousin asked me to choose one for the album, I left the date as unknown. The photograph shows the lantern, but it cannot settle our argument about the year.
